title: Service Groups Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the unified service groups configuration file.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service group.

name.description: Human-readable name of the service group.

items.description: ID of a service belonging to this group.

services.description: List of service IDs that belong to this group.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the group was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the group was last updated.

synonyms.description: Alternative names or keywords for the group.

autoStart.description: Whether services in this group should auto-start.

enabled.description: Whether the service group is enabled.
